name: prompt-cache-control
description: Prompt-cache meter above the Claude Code prompt: how many tokens each request read from, wrote to and sent past the cache, a live countdown to the cache's expiry, and what to do about it (keep going, compact or clear). The TTL follows Claude Code's own rules for your account (1 hour on a Claude subscription, 5 minutes on an API key, cloud provider or usage credits, plus the TTL variables and setting) and corrects itself from request timing. /cache opens a per-turn table; /keepwarm pings the cache after idle stretches so it never lapses (ported from cache-tax).

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the cache lives after a request: auto follows Claude Code's own rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, the promptCacheTtl setting, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1 hour on a Claude subscription and 5 minutes on an API key, cloud provider or usage credits) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

warnSeconds.title: Warn before expiry (s)
warnSeconds.description: Seconds left on the countdown at which the band turns yellow and a toast reminds you the cache is about to lapse

compactAtTokens.title: Large context (tokens)
compactAtTokens.description: From this prompt size up, an expired cache suggests /compact (or /clear) before you pay to write the whole prefix again

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show the meter as a row above the prompt

breakdown.title: Token breakdown in the band
breakdown.description: Show the read / wrote / new token counts in the band above the prompt

status.title: Status line entry
status.description: Also pin a short entry (hit rate and countdown) under the prompt

limit.title: 5-hour window under the prompt
limit.description: Show how much of the 5-hour plan window is used and when it resets (5h 42% · reset 2h13m) under the prompt; only on a Claude subscription

autoKeepwarm.title: Start keepwarm with each message
autoKeepwarm.description: Open a 6-hour keepwarm window after a message whenever none is running, so the cache is pinged through idle stretches; /keepwarm off (or the pane's stop) keeps it off until you start it again. Pings cost a cache read each

toast.title: Toast near expiry
toast.description: Toasts as the cache lapses: at the warning threshold, then at 10, 3, 2 and 1 seconds, once per cache entry each (only for prompts of 20k tokens or more)

guard.title: Cold-cache guard
guard.description: A message to a cold cache of 50k tokens or more: refuse sends it only the second time, with its price shown (as cache-tax did); warn sends it and logs the price; off does nothing
